Air India Pilot Suspended After Failing Alcohol Test in Zurich

An Air India pilot was suspended after failing a pre-flight breathalyzer test for alcohol in Zurich before a flight to Delhi on September 6. The pilot was removed from duty. This incident follows a previous report of a pilot failing a test for marijuana and alcohol.
